judgement_notes: Round 1 (2026-11-01-r1) evidence applied: verified-on-title -> impl (H.264 NVDEC/VIC MK8D, Vorbis movie audio LAS, NSZ real, personalized tickets real keypair, audin real capture). Rule for items no title of the four uses: synthetic tests justify impl only when the layout/protocol under test comes from an authoritative source (real data from the material, public reference headers such as libnx/LibHac, real GLSLC programs) and no documented branch is refused; tests against self-authored layouts stay partial. Hence impl: audren perf (reference structs), GC/Palma/NES styles (libnx), bcat storage (LibHac), geometry shaders (real dumped GLSLC programs replay); partial: tess/XFB (self-authored control layouts), MSAA (refused Downsample/copy branches), texture views (cube/integer/sparse fallbacks), nvjpg/msenc/nvdisp, NCA0/2. Vorbis/Opus movie audio -> impl (Vorbis verified, Opus is not a movie-library type); AAC/VP8 moved to a separate descriptive gap with a media -0.02 adjustment. NVN catalog gap found by diffing the titles' NVN name strings and lookup warnings against names.txt (14 public names; ~36 more NVX/internal names in the SDK driver are not application API). Stale verified.json keys 'Maxwell shader ISA/{TLD,LDS,STS}' removed (wrong domain key, never applied; LDS/STS are translated). Unreachable on this Mac: nvhost-gpu node layouts, IR camera, NCA0/NCA2 retail validation, tess/XFB/MSAA/nvjpg/msenc/nvdisp title evidence (no title in the material).
